            <Email Address="customer@customer.com" NameNumber="1.1" Type="TO"/>
            <Email Address="agency@agency.com" Type="BC"/>
            <PersonName NameNumber="1.1" PassengerType="ADT">
                <GivenName>MAX</GivenName>
                <Surname>POWER</Surname>
            </PersonName>
        </CustomerInfo>

        <RetryRebook Option="true"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="HL"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="HN"/>

                <MarketingAirline Code="SU" FlightNumber="1138"/>
                <OriginLocation LocationCode="SVO"/>

            <FlightSegment DepartureDateTime="{{end_date}}T00:00:00" FlightNumber="1129" NumberInParty="1" ResBookDesigCode="Y" Status="NN">

    <PostProcessing>

    <TravelItineraryAddInfo>
        <AgencyInfo>
            <Ticketing TicketType="7TAW"/>
        </AgencyInfo>
        <CustomerInfo>
            <ContactNumbers>
                <ContactNumber Phone="74991234567" PhoneUseType="A"/>
                <ContactNumber NameNumber="1.1" Phone="79851234567" PhoneUseType="M"/>
            </ContactNumbers>
            <Email Address="customer@customer.com" NameNumber="1.1" Type="TO"/>
            <Email Address="agency@agency.com" Type="BC"/>
            <PersonName NameNumber="1.1" PassengerType="ADT">
                <GivenName>MAX</GivenName>
                <Surname>POWER</Surname>
            </PersonName>
        </CustomerInfo>
    </TravelItineraryAddInfo>
    <AirBook>
        <RetryRebook Option="true"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="HL"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="HN"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="HX"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="LL"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="NN"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="NO"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="PN"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="UC"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="UN"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="US"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="UU"/>
        <OriginDestinationInformation>
            <FlightSegment DepartureDateTime="{{start_date}}T00:00:00" FlightNumber="1138" NumberInParty="1" ResBookDesigCode="Y" Status="NN">
                <DestinationLocation LocationCode="AER"/>
                <MarketingAirline Code="SU" FlightNumber="1138"/>
                <OriginLocation LocationCode="SVO"/>
            </FlightSegment>
            <FlightSegment DepartureDateTime="{{end_date}}T00:00:00" FlightNumber="1129" NumberInParty="1" ResBookDesigCode="Y" Status="NN">
                <DestinationLocation LocationCode="SVO"/>
                <MarketingAirline Code="SU" FlightNumber="1129"/>
                <OriginLocation LocationCode="AER"/>
            </FlightSegment>
        </OriginDestinationInformation>
        <RedisplayReservation NumAttempts="10" WaitInterval="1000"/>
    </AirBook>
    <AirPrice>
        <PriceRequestInformation Retain="true">
            <OptionalQualifiers>
                <FlightQualifiers>
                    <VendorPrefs>
                        <Airline Code="SU"/>
                    </VendorPrefs>
                </FlightQualifiers>
                <PricingQualifiers>
                    <Brand>EC</Brand>
                </PricingQualifiers>
            </OptionalQualifiers>
        </PriceRequestInformation>
    </AirPrice>
    <SpecialReqDetails>
        <SpecialService>
            <SpecialServiceInfo>
                <AdvancePassenger SegmentNumber="A">
                    <Document ExpirationDate="2020-11-20" Number="1234567890" Type="P">
                        <IssueCountry>RU</IssueCountry>
                        <NationalityCountry>RU</NationalityCountry>
                    </Document>
                    <PersonName DateOfBirth="1980-11-20" DocumentHolder="true" Gender="M" NameNumber="1.1">
                        <GivenName>MAX</GivenName>
                        <MiddleName>IVANOVICH</MiddleName>
                        <Surname>POWER</Surname>
                    </PersonName>
                </AdvancePassenger>
            </SpecialServiceInfo>
        </SpecialService>
    </SpecialReqDetails>
    <PostProcessing>
        <EndTransaction>
            <Source ReceivedFrom="API"/>
        </EndTransaction>
        <RedisplayReservation waitInterval="100"/>
    </PostProcessing>
</CreatePassengerNameRecordRQ>

{{footer}}

{{header}}

<CreatePassengerNameRecordRQ haltOnAirPriceError="true" targetCity="{{pcc_tkt}}" version="2.3.0" xmlns="http://services.sabre.com/sp/reservation/v2_3">
    <TravelItineraryAddInfo>
        <AgencyInfo>
            <Ticketing TicketType="7TAW"/>
        </AgencyInfo>
        <CustomerInfo>
            <ContactNumbers>
                <ContactNumber Phone="74991234567" PhoneUseType="A"/>
                <ContactNumber NameNumber="1.1" Phone="79851234567" PhoneUseType="M"/>
            </ContactNumbers>
            <Email Address="customer@customer.com" NameNumber="1.1" Type="TO"/>
            <Email Address="agency@agency.com" Type="BC"/>
            <PersonName NameNumber="1.1" PassengerType="ADT">
                <GivenName>MAX</GivenName>
                <Surname>POWER</Surname>
            </PersonName>
        </CustomerInfo>
    </TravelItineraryAddInfo>
    <AirBook>
        <RetryRebook Option="true"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="HL"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="HN"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="HX"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="LL"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="NN"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="NO"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="PN"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="UC"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="UN"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="US"/>
        <HaltOnStatus Code="UU"/>
        <OriginDestinationInformation>
            <FlightSegment DepartureDateTime="{{start_date}}T00:00:00" FlightNumber="1138" NumberInParty="1" ResBookDesigCode="Y" Status="NN">
                <DestinationLocation LocationCode="AER"/>
                <MarketingAirline Code="SU" FlightNumber="1138"/>
                <OriginLocation LocationCode="SVO"/>
            </FlightSegment>
            <FlightSegment DepartureDateTime="{{end_date}}T00:00:00" FlightNumber="1129" NumberInParty="1" ResBookDesigCode="Y" Status="NN">
                <DestinationLocation LocationCode="SVO"/>
                <MarketingAirline Code="SU" FlightNumber="1129"/>
                <OriginLocation LocationCode="AER"/>
            </FlightSegment>
        </OriginDestinationInformation>
        <RedisplayReservation NumAttempts="10" WaitInterval="1000"/>
    </AirBook>
    <AirPrice>
        <PriceRequestInformation Retain="true">
            <OptionalQualifiers>
                <FlightQualifiers>
                    <VendorPrefs>
                        <Airline Code="SU"/>
                    </VendorPrefs>
                </FlightQualifiers>
                <PricingQualifiers>
                    <Brand>EC</Brand>
                </PricingQualifiers>
            </OptionalQualifiers>
        </PriceRequestInformation>
    </AirPrice>
    <SpecialReqDetails>
        <SpecialService>
            <SpecialServiceInfo>
                <AdvancePassenger SegmentNumber="A">
                    <Document ExpirationDate="2020-11-20" Number="1234567890" Type="P">
                        <IssueCountry>RU</IssueCountry>
                        <NationalityCountry>RU</NationalityCountry>
                    </Document>
                    <PersonName DateOfBirth="1980-11-20" DocumentHolder="true" Gender="M" NameNumber="1.1">
                        <GivenName>MAX</GivenName>
                        <MiddleName>IVANOVICH</MiddleName>
                        <Surname>POWER</Surname>
                    </PersonName>
                </AdvancePassenger>
            </SpecialServiceInfo>
        </SpecialService>
    </SpecialReqDetails>
    <PostProcessing>
        <EndTransaction>
            <Source ReceivedFrom="API"/>
        </EndTransaction>
        <RedisplayReservation waitInterval="100"/>
    </PostProcessing>
</CreatePassengerNameRecordRQ>

{{footer}}

{{header}}

<AirTicketRQ targetCity="{{pcc_tkt}}" version="1.2.1" xmlns="http://services.sabre.com/sp/air/ticket/v1_2_1">
    <DesignatePrinter>
        <Printers>
            <Hardcopy LNIATA="{{ptrta}}"/>
            <Ticket CountryCode="{{country_code}}"/>
        </Printers>
    </DesignatePrinter>
    <Itinerary ID="{{pnr}}"/>
    <Ticketing>
        <FOP_Qualifiers>
            <BasicFOP Type="CA"/>
        </FOP_Qualifiers>
        <MiscQualifiers>
            <Commission Amount="100"/>
            <Ticket Type="ETR"/>
        </MiscQualifiers>
        <PricingQualifiers>
            <PriceQuote>
                <Record Number="1"/>
            </PriceQuote>
        </PricingQualifiers>
    </Ticketing>
    <PostProcessing acceptNegotiatedFare="true" acceptPriceChanges="true" actionOnPQExpired="Q"/>
</AirTicketRQ>

{{footer}}
